text: A useful integration technique recognizes the structure that differentiation would create. Here the outside is a power, the inside is x squared plus two, and the nearby factor two x is exactly the inside's derivative.
title: Idea 1

formula: u=x^2+2, quad dif u=2x dif x
text: Name the inside u. The entire combination two x times d x becomes d u, so the integral becomes u cubed with respect to u. This substitution reverses the chain rule; it does not simply delete an inconvenient factor.
title: Idea 2

text: Integrating u cubed gives u to the fourth divided by four, plus a constant. Substitute the original inside back into the answer. Differentiating this result recreates both the outer cube and the required factor two x.
title: Idea 3

formula: integral x e^x dif x=x e^x-e^x+C
text: Products may call for integration by parts, the reverse of the product rule. Choose u equal to x and d v equal to exponential x d x. Subtracting the remaining exponential integral gives an answer you can verify by differentiating.
title: Idea 4
